I am writing to formally raise a serious concern regarding the maternity care my wife received at Borders General Hospital.

My wife’s due date was on the 8th. On the 10th, she began experiencing clear signs of labour. She was already 4 cm dilated, had discharge with unusual colour, and was suffering from very painful and frequent contractions. Naturally, we were extremely worried and went to the hospital for examination and support.

However, after being assessed, the nurses advised my wife to return home and wait another 3–4 days before coming back. We were not given a clear or sufficient explanation for this decision. Given that she was already past her due date, 4 cm dilated, and in significant pain, we felt this advice was unsafe and very concerning.

Because we were not reassured and feared for the safety of both mother and baby, I decided to take my wife to a hospital in Edinburgh. Within one day of being admitted there, she safely delivered our baby. This outcome has left us confused and deeply concerned about the judgment and decision-making at Borders General Hospital. If we had followed the advice to wait several more days, I fear the consequences could have been serious.

We are an Asian family, and while I sincerely hope that this situation was not influenced by discrimination, the lack of clear explanation and the dismissal of my wife’s condition has caused us to question whether we were treated fairly and with the same level of care as other patients.

We are not writing this complaint to create conflict, but to seek clarity and accountability. We respectfully request a full explanation of why my wife was sent home despite being 4 cm dilated, past her due date, and in severe pain. We also hope the hospital will review its procedures to ensure that no other family experiences similar distress.

We look forward to your response.",null,[0,97]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sbU1tUmxUSFJWZERGbVgySnRWMmhzYldadVMwRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xeb61a43f5a24220a!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmlmMmRlTHRVdDFmX2JtV2hsbWZuS0E%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21sbU1tUmxUSFJWZERGbVgySnRWMmhzYldadVMwRRAB&t=1&_pGHrKgswZGFLc1hLN0RnSw&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiY28Sz96-TAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0QoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiY28Sz96-TAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0Q0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDlCTmtWdVRsOWZSV2hEWkcxUmFGazBhalZrZG05UE1qWk5PRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpTU1VOWk5FUnZVMk13V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s0MFRHMUNPRmxVZUc5NWRWSlFMVW96V2xsVVJrRRAB",["0x0:0xeb61a43f5a24220a",null,1770913461672001,1770913461672001,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116303148292964867780/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Anne","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIPAMyRYxALp_3zCCIMXIauE6ajT_c5ew8W_3zWi_-ZxbeXSg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116303148292964867780?hl=en"],"116303148292964867780",null,1,0,null,[0,1,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiY28Sz96-TAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0Q7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Always prompt efficient care in outpatients.
